scope: ST/VE approved native packets only; TS pending

rows.sourceEnglish: The route must not erode the slope or send damaging water to a neighbour. A downstream swale or dam must be able to receive it safely.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Route eo ha e a tshwanela ho senya slope ka erosion kapa ho romela metsi a senyang ho moahisani. Downstream swale kapa dam e lokela ho kgona ho amohela metsi ao ka polokeho.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Tsela ha e a lokela ho baka erosion moepeng kapa ho romela metsi a senyang ho moahisani. A downstream swale or dam must be able to receive it safely.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Tsela ha e a lokela ho baka kgoholeho moepeng kapa ho romela metsi a senyang ho moahisani. Downstream swale kapa letamo di tlameha ho kgona ho amohela metsi ao ka polokeho.

rows.sourceEnglish: Ask a trained local adviser to assess the soil, slope and storm flow. A picture is not a construction design.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Kopa trained local adviser hore a hlahlobe mobu, slope le storm flow. Setshwantsho ha se construction design.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Kopa trained local adviser hore a hlahlobe mobu, slope le storm flow. Setshwantsho hase construction design.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Kopa moeletsi wa sebaka seo ya kwetlisitsweng hore a hlahlobe mobu, letswapo le storm flow. Setshwantsho hase moralo wa kaho.

rows.sourceEnglish: Slope alone does not tell you whether a swale is suitable. Soil, drainage, unstable ground and the water arriving from upslope all matter.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Slope feela ha e bolele hore swale e a lokela. Soil, drainage, unstable ground le metsi a tswang upslope kaofela di bohlokwa.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Slope feela ha e bolele hore swale e loketse. Soil, drainage, unstable ground le metsi a tswang upslope kaofela di bohlokwa.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Letswapo feela ha le bolele hore swale e loketse. Mobu, drainage, mobu o sa tsitsang le metsi a tswang hodimo ho letswapo kaofela di bohlokwa.

rows.sourceEnglish: Keep good ground cover. Get a local assessment before digging on steep, wet or unstable land. Grass barriers and terraces also need a design suited to the site.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Boloka ground cover e ntle. Fumana local assessment pele o tjheka mobung o steep, wet kapa unstable. Grass barriers le terraces le tsona di hloka design e loketseng site.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Boloka ground cover e ntle. Fumana local assessment pele o tjheka sebakeng se steep, wet kapa unstable. Grass barriers le terraces le tsona di hloka design e loketseng site.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Boloka sekwahelo se setle sa mobu. Fumana tlhahlobo ya sebaka seo pele o tjheka sebakeng se moepa, se metsi kapa se sa tsitsang. Dithibelo tsa jwang le terraces le tsona di hloka moralo o loketseng setsha.

rows.sourceEnglish: Water can be lost through evaporation and seepage. Check the water level and look for leaks or erosion.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Metsi a ka lahleha ka evaporation le seepage. Hlahloba water level mme o batle dibaka tse dutlang kapa kgoholeho.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Metsi a ka lahleha ka evaporation le seepage. Hlahloba boemo ba metsi mme o batle dibaka tse dutlang kapa kgoholeho.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Metsi a ka lahleha ka evaporation le seepage. Hlahloba boemo ba metsi mme o batle dibaka tse dutlang kapa kgoholeho.

rows.sourceEnglish: Keep the spillway clear and maintain the bank cover specified in the design. Do not plant trees on an earth dam wall.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Keep the spillway clear and maintain the bank cover specified in the design. O se ke wa jala difate hodima lerako la letamo la mobu.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Boloka spillway e sa thibehang mme o hlokomele bank cover e boletsweng design. O se ke wa jala difate hodima lerako la earth dam.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Boloka spillway e sa thibehang mme o hlokomele sekwahelo sa lebopo se boletsweng moralong. O se ke wa jala difate hodima lerako la letamo la mobu.

rows.sourceEnglish: Use the roof area seen from above and local rainfall records. Then allow for water that misses the gutter, is diverted or overflows a full tank.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Sebedisa boholo ba marulelo jwalo ka ha bo bonwa ho tloha hodimo le ditlaleho tsa pula ya sebaka seo. Ebe o dumella metsi a fosang koto, a kgelohang kapa a kgaphatsehang ha tanka e tletse.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Sebedisa boholo ba marulelo jwalo ka ha bo bonwa ho tloha hodimo le ditlaleho tsa pula ya sebaka seo. Then allow for water that misses the gutter, is diverted or overflows a full tank.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Sebedisa boholo ba marulelo jwalo ka ha bo bonwa ho tloha hodimo le ditlaleho tsa pula ya sebaka seo. Jwale o nahanele metsi a sa keneng ka gutter, a kgeloswang kapa a tsholohang tankeng e tletseng.

rows.sourceEnglish: Roof runoff can carry dust, droppings and other contamination. A first-flush diverter keeps some of the first runoff out of the tank.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Metsi a theohang marulelong a ka nka lerole, mantle le tshilafalo e nngwe. Sekgelo sa ho qala ha phallo (first-flush diverter) se boloka karolo e nngwe ya metsi a pele a phallang kantle ho tanka.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Metsi a theohang marulelong a ka nka lerole, mantle le tshilafalo e nngwe. A first-flush diverter keeps some of the first runoff out of the tank.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Metsi a theohang marulelong a ka nka lerole, mantle le tshilafalo e nngwe. First-flush diverter e thibela metsi a mang a phallo ya pele ho kena ka tankeng.

rows.sourceEnglish: The required diversion depends on the roof and system. Use the supplier's sizing and maintenance instructions; there is no single volume for every roof.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Bongata bo hlokahalang ba ho kgeloha bo itshetlehile ka marulelo le tsamaiso. Use the supplier's sizing and maintenance instructions; there is no single volume for every roof.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Bongata bo lokelang ho kgeloswa bo itshetlehile ka marulelo le system. Latela ditaelo tsa supplier tsa sizing le maintenance; ha ho volume e le nngwe bakeng sa marulelo ohle.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Bongata bo lokelang ho kgeloswa bo itshetlehile ka marulelo le tsamaiso. Latela ditaelo tsa mofani mabapi le ho lekanya boholo le ho hlokomela; ha ho volume e le nngwe bakeng sa marulelo ohle.

rows.sourceEnglish: Tank size depends on water demand, rain, roof area and the length of dry periods.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Boholo ba tanka bo itshetlehile ka tlhoko ya metsi, pula, boholo ba marulelo le the length of dry periods.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Boholo ba tank bo itshetlehile ka tlhoko ya metsi, pula, sebaka sa marulelo le bolelele ba dry periods.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Boholo ba tanka bo itshetlehile ka tlhoko ya metsi, pula, sebaka sa marulelo le bolelele ba dry periods.

rows.sourceEnglish: List the intended uses and estimate their demand from your own records. Compare that with supply through the seasons.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Ngola tshebediso e rerilweng mme o hakanye tlhoko ya yona ho tswa ditlalehong tsa hao. Bapisa seo le phepelo ho pholletsa le dihla.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Ngola intended uses mme o hakanye demand ya tsona o sebedisa records tsa hao. Bapisa demand ya tsona le phepelo ho pholletsa le dihla.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Ngola ditshebediso tse rerilweng mme o hakanye tlhoko ya tsona o sebedisa ditlaleho tsa hao. Bapisa tlhoko ya tsona le phepelo ho pholletsa le dihla.

rows.sourceEnglish: Plan what you will do when stored water runs low. A province name alone cannot tell you the tank size you need.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Rala seo o tla se etsa ha metsi a bolokilweng a qala ho fela. Lebitso la provense feela le ke ke la o jwetsa boholo ba tanka eo o e hlokang.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Rala seo o tla se etsa ha stored water runs low. Lebitso la provense feela ha le bolele boholo ba tank boo o bo hlokang.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Rala seo o tla se etsa ha metsi a bolokilweng a se a le manyenyane. Lebitso la provense feela ha le bolele boholo ba tanka boo o bo hlokang.

rows.sourceEnglish: Keep the tank covered, screen openings against insects, and maintain the roof, gutters and diverter. Keep rainwater separate from drinking-water pipes.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Boloka tanka e kwahetswe, screen openings against insects, mme o hlokomele marulelo, dikoto le sekgelo (diverter). Boloka metsi a pula a arohane le diphaephe tsa metsi a nowang.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Kwahela tank, kwahela masoba ka mesh e thibelang dikokonyana, mme o hlokomele marulelo, gutters le diverter. Arola metsi a pula le diphaephe tsa drinking water.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Kwahela tanka, kwahela masoba ka mesh e thibelang dikokonyana, mme o hlokomele marulelo, mekero ya marulelo (gutters) le sekgelo (diverter). Arola metsi a pula le diphaephe tsa metsi a nowang.

rows.sourceEnglish: Water that looks clear may still contain germs or chemicals. Ask the local health authority about testing and treatment suited to the intended use.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Water that looks clear may still contain germs or chemicals. Botsa balaodi ba bophelo bo botle ba sebaka seo ka diteko le kalafo tse loketseng tshebediso e rerilweng.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Metsi a shebahalang a hlakile a ntse a ka ba le germs kapa chemicals. Botsa balaodi ba bophelo bo botle ba sebaka seo ka testing le treatment tse loketseng intended use.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Metsi a shebahalang a hlakile a ntse a ka ba le dikokwana-hloko kapa dikhemikhale. Botsa balaodi ba bophelo bo botle ba sebaka seo ka diteko le kalafo tse loketseng tshebediso e rerilweng.

rows.sourceEnglish: If a reuse system is already operating and the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, stop using it and seek qualified local advice.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Haeba reuse system e se e sebetsa mme the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, emisa ho a sebedisa mme o batle keletso ho qualified local adviser.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Haeba reuse system e se e sebetsa mme the water smells bad, pools or harms plants, emisa ho a sebedisa mme o batle keletso ho qualified local adviser.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Haeba tsamaiso ya ho sebedisa metsi hape e se e sebetsa mme metsi a nkga hampe, a bokellana a eme kapa a senya dimela, emisa ho a sebedisa mme o batle keletso ho qualified local adviser.

rows.sourceEnglish: Heavy rain can fill a swale faster than water soaks into the soil. Plan a safe overflow before digging.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Pula khulwane i nga ḓadza swale nga u ṱavhanya u fhira u dzhena ha maḓi mavuni. Plan a safe overflow before digging.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Heavy rain can fill a swale faster than water soaks into the soil. Pulani safe overflow ni sa athu u bwa.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Mvula khulwane i nga ḓadza swale nga luvhilo lu fhiraho lune maḓi a dzhena ngalwo mavuni. Pulani safe overflow ni sa athu u bwa.

rows.sourceEnglish: The route must not erode the slope or send damaging water to a neighbour. A downstream swale or dam must be able to receive it safely.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Route a i tei u erode slope kana u rumela damaging water kha neighbour. A downstream swale or dam must be able to receive it safely.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Route a i tei u erode slope kana u rumela damaging water kha neighbour. A downstream swale or dam must be able to receive it safely.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Nḓila a i tei u erode slope kana u rumela maḓi a tshinyaho kha muhura. A downstream swale or dam must be able to receive it safely.

rows.sourceEnglish: Ask a trained local adviser to assess the soil, slope and storm flow. A picture is not a construction design.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Humbelani trained local adviser uri a assess soil, slope na storm flow. Tshifanyiso a si construction design.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Humbelani trained local adviser uri a assess soil, slope na storm flow. Tshifanyiso a si construction design.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Humbelani trained local adviser uri a ṱole mavu, slope na storm flow. Tshifanyiso a si construction design.

rows.sourceEnglish: Slope alone does not tell you whether a swale is suitable. Soil, drainage, unstable ground and the water arriving from upslope all matter.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Slope fhedzi a i sumbedzi arali swale i suitable. Soil, drainage, unstable ground na maḓi ane a bva upslope zwoṱhe zwi na ndeme.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Slope fhedzi a i sumbedzi arali swale i suitable. Soil, drainage, unstable ground na maḓi ane a bva upslope zwoṱhe zwi na ndeme.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Slope fhedzi a i sumbedzi arali swale yo tea. Mavu, drainage, unstable ground na maḓi ane a bva upslope zwoṱhe zwi na ndeme.

rows.sourceEnglish: Keep good ground cover. Get a local assessment before digging on steep, wet or unstable land. Grass barriers and terraces also need a design suited to the site.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Keep good ground cover. Wanani local assessment ni sa athu u bwa kha steep, wet kana unstable land. Grass barriers na terraces na zwone zwi ṱoḓa design yo teaho site.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Keep good ground cover. Wanani local assessment ni sa athu u bwa kha steep, wet kana unstable land. Grass barriers na terraces na zwone zwi ṱoḓa design yo teaho site.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Vhulungani ground cover yavhuḓi. Wanani local assessment ni sa athu u bwa kha steep, wet kana unstable land. Grass barriers na terraces na zwone zwi ṱoḓa design yo teaho site.

rows.sourceEnglish: A dam or pond can store runoff, but the amount available depends on local rain, the catchment, losses and how much water you use.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Dam kana pond i nga vhulunga runoff, fhedzi maḓi ane a wanala a bva kha mvula ya henefho, catchment, losses na uri ni shumisa maḓi mangana.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Dam kana pond i nga vhulunga runoff, fhedzi maḓi ane a wanala a bva kha mvula ya henefho, catchment, losses na uri ni shumisa maḓi mangana.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Dam kana pond i nga vhulunga runoff, fhedzi maḓi ane a wanala a bva kha mvula ya henefho, catchment, maḓi a xelaho na uri ni shumisa maḓi mangana.

rows.sourceEnglish: Rainfall seasons differ across South Africa. Use local records and plan for dry periods; a full dam is not guaranteed.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Tshifhinga tsha mvula tshi a fhambana u mona na Afurika Tshipembe. Shumisani local records ni pulanele dry periods; dam yo ḓalaho a yo khwaṱhisedzwi.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Tshifhinga tsha mvula tshi a fhambana u mona na Afurika Tshipembe. Shumisani local records nahone ni pulanele dry periods; dam yo ḓalaho a yo khwaṱhisedzwi.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Tshifhinga tsha mvula tshi a fhambana u mona na Afurika Tshipembe. Shumisani rekhodo dza henefho nahone ni pulanele zwifhinga zwo omaho; dam yo ḓalaho a yo khwaṱhisedzwi.

rows.sourceEnglish: A dam needs a site investigation and a design by a suitably qualified person. Catchment runoff, soil, foundations, downstream risk and a safe spillway all matter.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Dam i ṱoḓa site investigation na design yo itwaho nga suitably qualified person. Catchment runoff, soil, foundations, downstream risk na safe spillway zwoṱhe zwi na ndeme.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Dam i ṱoḓa site investigation na design yo itwaho nga suitably qualified person. Catchment runoff, soil, foundations, downstream risk na safe spillway zwoṱhe zwi na ndeme.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Dam i ṱoḓa site investigation na design yo itwaho nga suitably qualified person. Catchment runoff, mavu, foundations, downstream risk na safe spillway zwoṱhe zwi na ndeme.

rows.sourceEnglish: Do not assume that annual rainfall tells you the size of a flood or the storage you will have.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Ni songo humbula uri annual rainfall i ni vhudza size ya flood kana storage ine na ḓo vha nayo.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Ni songo humbula uri annual rainfall i ni vhudza size ya flood kana storage ine na ḓo vha nayo.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Ni songo humbula uri mvula ya ṅwaha woṱhe i ni vhudza vhuhulwane ha flood kana storage ine na ḓo vha nayo.

rows.sourceEnglish: An uncontrolled overflow can erode and breach the wall. Plan a safe route for excess water before construction.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Overflow i songo langiwaho i nga erode na breach wall. Pulani safe route ya excess water ni sa athu u thoma construction.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Overflow i songo langiwaho i nga erode na breach wall. Pulani safe route ya excess water ni sa athu u thoma construction.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Overflow i songo langiwaho i nga erode na breach wall. Pulani nḓila yo tsireledzeaho ya maḓi o engedzeaho ni sa athu u thoma construction.

rows.sourceEnglish: Keep the spillway clear and maintain the bank cover specified in the design. Do not plant trees on an earth dam wall.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Keep spillway i clear nahone maintain bank cover yo bulwaho kha design. Do not plant trees on earth dam wall.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Keep the spillway clear and maintain the bank cover specified in the design. Ni songo ṱavha trees kha earth dam wall.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Itani uri spillway i dzule i si na zwine zwa i thivhela nahone ni ṱhogomele bank cover yo bulwaho kha design. Ni songo ṱavha miri kha earth dam wall.

rows.sourceEnglish: Animals can damage banks and add manure to the water. Their presence does not make the water clean or safe.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Animals can damage banks and add manure to the water. U vha hone hadzo a hu iti uri maḓi a vhe clean kana safe.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Animals can damage banks and add manure to the water. U vha hone hadzo a hu iti uri maḓi a vhe clean kana safe.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Zwipuka zwi nga tshinya banks nahone zwa engedza manure kha maḓi. U vha hone hadzo a hu iti uri maḓi a vhe o kunaho kana o tsireledzeaho.

rows.sourceEnglish: Use the roof area seen from above and local rainfall records. Then allow for water that misses the gutter, is diverted or overflows a full tank.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Shumisani roof area ine ya vhonala u bva nṱha na local rainfall records. Then allow for water that misses the gutter, is diverted or overflows a full tank.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Shumisani roof area ine ya vhonala u bva nṱha na local rainfall records. Then allow for water that misses the gutter, is diverted or overflows a full tank.
rows.decision: read-only exact source whole-paragraph reuse; root actual current deck diff review required
rows.proposedTarget: Shumisani vhuhulwane ha ṱhanga vhune ha vhonala u bva nṱha na rekhodo dza mvula dza henefho. Nga murahu ni dzhiele nṱha maḓi ane a si dzhene kha gutter, ane a diverted kana ane a overflow kha tank yo ḓalaho.

rows.sourceEnglish: Roof runoff can carry dust, droppings and other contamination. A first-flush diverter keeps some of the first runoff out of the tank.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Roof runoff i nga hwala buse, droppings na iṅwe contamination. First-flush diverter i thivhela maṅwe maḓi a first runoff uri a si dzhene kha tank.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Roof runoff i nga hwala buse, droppings na iṅwe contamination. First-flush diverter i thivhela maṅwe maḓi a first runoff uri a si dzhene kha tank.

rows.currentDeckTarget: Diversion ine ya ṱoḓea i ḓitika nga ṱhanga na system. Shumisani ndaela dza supplier dza sizing na maintenance; a hu na volume nthihi fhedzi ine ya shuma kha ṱhanga iṅwe na iṅwe.

rows.sourceEnglish: Tank size depends on water demand, rain, roof area and the length of dry periods.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Tank size i ḓitika nga water demand, mvula, roof area na vhulapfu ha tshifhinga tsha dry periods.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Tank size i bva kha water demand, mvula, roof area na vhulapfu ha dry periods.

rows.proposedTarget: Vhuhulwane ha tank vhu bva kha water demand, mvula, vhuhulwane ha ṱhanga na vhulapfu ha dry periods.

rows.sourceEnglish: List the intended uses and estimate their demand from your own records. Compare that with supply through the seasons.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Ṅwalani intended uses nahone ni anganyele demand yayo ni tshi shumisa records dzaṋu. Vhambedzani demand yayo na supply u mona na seasons.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Ṅwalani intended uses nahone ni anganyele demand yayo ni tshi shumisa records dzaṋu. Vhambedzani demand yayo na supply u mona na seasons.

rows.sourceEnglish: Plan what you will do when stored water runs low. A province name alone cannot tell you the tank size you need.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Pulannani zwine na ḓo ita musi stored water runs low. Dzina ḽa province fhedzi a ḽi ni vhudzi tank size ine na i ṱoḓa.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Pulannani zwine na ḓo ita musi stored water runs low. Dzina ḽa province fhedzi a ḽi ni vhudzi tank size ine na i ṱoḓa.

rows.sourceEnglish: Keep the tank covered, screen openings against insects, and maintain the roof, gutters and diverter. Keep rainwater separate from drinking-water pipes.
rows.currentDeckTarget: Itani uri tank i dzule yo tibifhiwa; screen openings against insects, nahone ni maintain roof, gutters na diverter. Keep rainwater separate from drinking-water pipes.
rows.currentLearnerTarget: Itani uri tank i dzule yo tibifhiwa; screen openings against insects, nahone ni maintain roof, gutters na diverter. Keep rainwater separate from drinking-water pipes.

rows.proposedTarget: Itani uri tank i dzule covered; vheani screen kha openings uri zwikhokhonono zwi si dzhene, nahone ni ṱhogomele ṱhanga, gutters na diverter. Vhulungani maḓi a mvula o fhambanywa na pipes dza maḓi a u nwa.

rows.sourceEnglish: Water that looks clear may still contain germs or chemicals. Ask the local health authority about testing and treatment suited to the intended use.
